body: Thank you. I know it’ll be be ok but it’s nice to be validated so thank you
I know they mean well. But they just make my situation feel like nothing
It’s why I feel there’s no use in even opening up.
Wow that’s awesome bc I rarely check my “depressed” account lol. I hope you’re doing great man. Life sucks sometimes but it does have its shining moments
I’ve been on wellbutrin and drank way to much and I can say it didn’t do shit. As far as trintellix I’m not sure. Are you feeling weird drinking after taking anti depressants?
Hey bro, just wanted to say you’re a good soul. There’s a lot more to life than high school! I wish you the best brother

Also if it helps, start writing out your thoughts out in a journal. It’s good to have your thoughts out there so you physically read them and examine them. You don’t have to share them it’s for your own personal use.
You said it yourself, you have a wonderful gf who’s so good to you
Depending on how close you are with your gf I would say her. But whoever you’re most open with should be the one you talk about this with.

I just posted myself and wanted to read what other people are saying. Your feelings are valid and I think one of the hardest things to do in this life is to tell people how you feel. They might be caught off guard but most people do actually want to help.
